files_modified.description: Replaced removed IThickClientLauncher.exportConfigurationToXml(...) with EDT 2025.2.3 exportFullXmlFromInfobase(...), preserving full XML export semantics and existing arguments.
Replaced IInfobaseAccessManager.getSettings(...) calls with resolveSettings(...), and RuntimeExecutionCommandBuilder.updateInfobase() with updateDatabaseConfiguration().
Replaced IInfobaseAccessManager.storeSettings(...) with updateSettings(...), preserving the stored InfobaseAccessSettings payload.

summary: Fixed the 5 EDT 2025.2.3 API incompatibilities in the requested 3 source files. No reflection was introduced; no new OSGi service tracker or MANIFEST.MF change was needed because the replacement methods are on the existing services/classes.
